Name: (AT) Jukebox Pink Recolor
Author: OofLasagna
Description:
I couldn't find many recolors for the jukebox, and I hated how much it stood out in my home, so I thought I'd give it a nice recolor. It only comes in pink for now, but hopefully I can add more colors. 

This is my first mod so please let me know if anything goes wrong :)

Installation:

1 )  Download the file.

2 )  Open the Zip file, and drag the file inside into your mods folder. It should be as easy as that!

3 ) In the game, you need to use the paint bucket tool (bought from Robin) on the jukebox!

Make sure you have Alternative Textures installed, or else it won't show up.
